definition: Predicting future values of a series from its history — the central forecasting task served by ARIMA, Prophet, and deep models like Temporal Fusion Transformer.
details: Predicting future values of a series from its history — the central forecasting task served by ARIMA, Prophet, and deep models like Temporal Fusion Transformer.

explainer.lead: Time series forecasting predicts future values of a series from its history. It is the central forecasting task served by ARIMA, Prophet and deep models such as the Temporal Fusion Transformer.

tiers.eli5: You look at how something changed day after day, like daily temperatures, and guess what it will be tomorrow.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers pick ARIMA, Prophet or deep models like the Temporal Fusion Transformer according to the problem, and evaluate against historical data; a pitfall is that different methods suit different series, so the model choice carries weight.
tiers.paperLevel: Formally, forecasting estimates future values of a chronologically indexed sequence from its observed past; common approaches include ARIMA, Prophet and the Temporal Fusion Transformer. No further formal guarantees are specified here.

explainer.example: A time series of daily temperature readings is used to predict the values for upcoming days.
